description.raw: '''Innate:''' Periodically, when '''LeBlanc''' is damaged to [[File:Health icon.png|15px|link=Health]] 40% '''maximum''' health, she creates a [[File:Shaco Hallucinate 2.png|20px|link=Champion_summoned_units#decoys|An icon representing the keyword Clone]] [[:Champion_summoned_units#decoys|clone]] of herself, after which they both instantly become [[File:Twilight Shroud old2.png|20px|link=Stealth#Invisibility|An icon representing the keyword Invisibility]] [[:Stealth#Invisibility|invisible]] for 1 second.
description.text: Innate: Periodically, when LeBlanc is damaged to  40% maximum health, she creates a clone of herself, after which they both instantly become invisible for 1 second.

description2.raw: The clone can cast basic attacks with no effect and lasts 8 seconds. Upon spawning, it starts moving up to 1900 units toward a random direction in front of '''LeBlanc's''' movement, determined at the moment of its spawning.
description2.text: The clone can cast basic attacks with no effect and lasts 8 seconds. Upon spawning, it starts moving up to 1900 units toward a random direction in front of LeBlanc's movement, determined at the moment of its spawning.

description3.text: See Pets for more details about LeBlanc's clone.

notes.raw: * The [[File:Shaco Hallucinate 2.png|20px|link=Champion_summoned_units#decoys|An icon representing the keyword Clone]] [[:Champion_summoned_units#decoys|clone]] has a [[Pets#Leash ranges|leash range]]. * If ''Mirror Image'' triggers while '''LeBlanc''' is tethering to a target with [[File:LeBlanc Ethereal Chains.png|20xpx|border|link=LeBlanc#Ethereal Chains|An icon for LeBlanc's ability Ethereal Chains]] [[LeBlanc#Ethereal Chains|Ethereal Chains]] (or its [[File:LeBlanc Mimic- Ethereal Chains.png|20xpx|border|link=LeBlanc#Mimic: Ethereal Chains|An icon for LeBlanc's ability Mimic: Ethereal Chains]] [[LeBlanc#Mimic: Ethereal Chains|Mimicked]] version), her clone will not produce a fake tether, giving away which is the real one. (unexpected) * Using a basic attack breaks the stealth at the end of the attack windup.
notes.text:
The clone has a leash range.
If Mirror Image triggers while LeBlanc is tethering to a target with Ethereal Chains (or its Mimicked version), her clone will not produce a fake tether, giving away which is the real one. (unexpected)
Using a basic attack breaks the stealth at the end of the attack windup.
